title: Scheduled actions
description: Run, pause, or edit schedule for server-created jobs

help.title: About Scheduled actions
help.overview: Scheduled actions are server-created jobs. This page lets operators control and tune existing jobs; it does not create jobs or invent their handlers.

sections.title: Available actions
items: Run a job now, pause it, or resume it.
Edit its name, description, cron expression, retry count, retry delay, timeout, and priority.
Choose how missed runs are handled: skip the backlog, run once, or catch up.

sections.title: Job identity
items: The handler and code identify the server job and are not authored on this page.
Check the schedule and retry settings carefully before resuming a paused job.
